description: A dataset of 1km Grid Road network density in China(2022） 2022年中国1km格网路网密度数据集 is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Zhang Dingxiang, Peng Jinfu (中国国土勘测规划院 China Land Survey and Planning Institute). Road network density is a basic indicator for evaluating the scale and level of regional road development. As a characterization indicator, the calculation and monitoring of road network density is an important indicator for evaluating regional transportation and economic development, and provides a reference basis for the formulation of urban road management and control ...
